_comment: Suppressed fenceline findings. Each entry is [cwe_id, file, code_line] and is
matched exactly, so it stops applying the moment that line changes -- which is
the point: a suppression must not outlive the code it was justified against.
Anything not listed here is still reported, and `make fenceline` still fails on
HIGH or above. Regenerate a full picture with:
CWE-22 src/app/services/cache.py -- _service_label() derives a Prometheus label
from an OSRM URL path, not a filesystem path. Nothing is opened, read or joined
to a path. The result is checked against the _SERVICES frozenset allowlist and
anything unrecognised collapses to 'other', so a '..' input yields 'other'. The
allowlist is the control, not the lstrip; test_unknown_collapses_to_other covers
it. The scanner pattern-matches lstrip('/') on a variable named 'endpoint'.
CWE-1327 src/app/main.py -- binding 0.0.0.0 is required: the gateway is reached
from outside its container or jail. Exposure is controlled at the boundary, by
the published port on the Docker path and by pf on the jail path (the jail binds
a loopback that is not reachable off-host until `make jail-publish`). The bind
address is configurable per deployment via JAIL_API_HOST.
